blocks.text: Residual wet machinery carries a filament that follows the forty-seventh pump pulse.
Appearance: A large original leech latches onto the body. Its eye and sucker sit in front on opaque character pixels while its free body wiggles slowly behind.
Care: Use the parasite treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery but does not replace treatment.
Story connection: Tracing its pulse could reveal a surviving maintenance route.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Story-established in The Green Lights Below.
